parent.title: My Child
parent.noChildBody: Your school links your child to your account. If this looks wrong, please contact the school office.
parent.sessionsEmptyBody: After each session with {{name}}, a short note from the therapist will appear here.
parent.aboutIntro: This is what the therapists know about {{name}}. It helps every therapist, even a new one, start on the right foot.
parent.suggestBody: You know {{name}} best. Send the care team a message and they will update this page.

about.emptyStaff: About Me for {{name}} is still empty. Adding communication, motivators and a few Do / Don't rules helps any therapist who covers a session.

history.title: Edit history
history.subtitle: Who changed what, and when
history.noneBody: Edits to About Me will be listed here.

edit.title: Edit About Me
edit.intro: Keep it short and practical. A therapist meeting {{name}} for the first time should understand them in 30 seconds.
edit.commNotesPh: e.g. Uses 2-word phrases; points to pictures for snacks
edit.sensoryPh: e.g. Seeks movement and deep pressure; covers ears in noisy rooms
edit.rulesHelper: Most important first. The top 3 appear on the Handover Brief.
edit.doPh: e.g. Give a 2-minute warning before transitions
edit.dontPh: e.g. Don't touch without telling him first
edit.listFull: Up to {{max}} rules. Remove one to add another.
edit.clinicalNote: Visible only to school admins, coordinators and this child's therapists.
edit.noAccessBody: Only this child's therapists, coordinators and school admins can edit About Me.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: Your changes on this screen will be lost.

workspace.title: Child
workspace.briefOnlyBody: You can see About Me and goals so the session goes smoothly. Session records and family contacts stay with the care team.
workspace.noAccessTitle: This profile isn't available to you
workspace.noAccessBody: Only the child's care team can open it. Ask a coordinator if you need access.

sessions.emptyBody: Logged sessions will appear here with their scores and changes.

homeTasks.emptyBody: Tasks you assign appear in the family's Home Practice tab.

messages.emptyBody: Care-team chats about this child will show here.
